plain: In 2004, in Iraq, possibly near the city of Tikrit, a clip from the Arab news network Al Jazeera showed a nearly invisible blob with limbs climbing up onto an American Abrams battle tank and down into the gunner's hatch. John Blitch, a scientist who worked for the Pentagon's advanced research agency, says he saw the clip, and he links it to the US news anchor Katie Couric, who he says played it about three times in slow motion. He tells it as a hint that some kind of invisibility technology was being used.
